records.rationale: Proves 7/9 MMS approximation guarantees in algorithmic game theory and explicitly formalizes and verifies its main results in Lean 4.

Formalizes SoCal's static/dynamic semantics and deductively proves Progress, Preservation, and Type-safety theorems for factored ADT traversals.
Proves finite-ring preimage cardinality bounds over Z_q for k-stage masked NTT pipelines and Montgomery reduction, verified in Lean 4 without sorry.
Proves discrete-time composite Lyapunov controllability, observability, and ISS robustness bounds for tool-mediated cyber defense, verified in Lean 4 with zero sorry.
Proves Theorems 1 and 6 and Propositions 3–4 using finite-dimensional C1 tangent transport, contraction graph transforms, and pseudoinverse covariance bounds.

Proves deterministic dynamical equivalents (Theorems 2.1, H.1) for stochastic Muon in proportional high-dimensional random-matrix limits (N_in, N_out, B -> infinity).
Proves modal soundness/completeness and social-choice characterization theorems (Theorems 1–4) over finite deviation frames, accompanied by a Lean proof companion.
